description: This file defines the DoNode class within the Twig templating engine, representing a 'do' node in the abstract syntax tree. It includes methods for constructing the node with an expression and for compiling that node into executable PHP code.

classes.name:
Twig
ode\DoNode
classes.description: Represents a 'do' node in the Twig abstract syntax tree, encapsulating an expression to be evaluated and compiled into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DoNode with an expression and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the DoNode into PHP code by emitting the expression code followed by a semicolon.
